overview_description.description: Sobot is a global leader in contact center solutions, offering a versatile platform that includes chatbot functionality, live chat, voice support, ticketing systems, messaging, and the WhatsApp Business API. Serving over 10,000 brands across diverse industries in 18+ languages, our clients include renowned names such as Samsung, OPPO, Philips, Tineco, DFS, Renogy, Weee!, Michael Kors, J&T, Air Liquide, OPay, Mico, and Lilith Games.

product.name: Sobot Customer Service Platform
product.description: An omnichannel contact center and customer service platform for managing customer interactions, support workflows, customer data, ticketing, live chat, CRM records, call center operations, AI automation, and analytics.

product.name: Sobot Voicebot
product.description: An AI voice service for inbound customer support and outbound engagement, using speech recognition, NLP, LLMs, text-to-speech, multilingual processing, and human-agent handoff.

product.name: Sobot Voice for Sales
product.description: An outbound calling and telemarketing platform for lead reactivation, lead tracking, follow-up, surveys, campaign management, automated dialing, call recording, analytics, and AI-assisted sales conversations.

product.name: Sobot Mobile Office
product.description: A mobile application for customer service teams to handle live chat, tickets, calls, CRM records, and service data remotely from smartphones.

product.name: Sobot WhatsApp Business API
product.description: A WhatsApp Business API service for customer engagement, two-way communication, marketing, and support, integrated with Sobot’s omnichannel customer service platform.
